name: menu-engineering-bcg
title: Menu Engineering BCG (analytics module 2)
description: Implement Menu Engineering BCG quadrant analysis per A6 contract. For each active product, compute units_sold, revenue, recipe_cost, gp_per_unit, contribution, median volume & margin, then assign quadrant (STAR/PLOWHORSE/PUZZLE/DOG). Pre-compute into menu_performance_cache via scheduled job; invalidate on product price/recipe change.
acceptance: V35 migration: CREATE TABLE menu_performance_cache with columns (product_id, product_name, category_id, category_name, period_key, bucket, units_sold INT, revenue DECIMAL(14,2), recipe_cost DECIMAL(14,2), gross_profit_per_unit DECIMAL(14,2), total_contribution DECIMAL(14,2), quadrant VARCHAR(20), updated_at TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(product_id, period_key, bucket))
V35 migration: CREATE INDEX idx_mpc_period ON menu_performance_cache (bucket, period_key)
MenuEngineeringReport domain record with nested PeriodInfo, MenuItemSummary, CacheStatus fields per §5.2 contract shape
MenuEngineeringCacheRepositoryPort + JPA entity + adapter for CRUD on cache table

RefreshMenuEngineeringService: computes BCG for all active products in a period. Math: units_sold = COUNT(order_details) per product; revenue = Σ(unit_price); recipe_cost = Σ(ProductRecipe.requiredQuantity × SupplyVariant.unitCost); gp_per_unit = sell_price − recipe_cost; contribution = units_sold × gp_per_unit; median_volume = median(units_sold); median_margin = median(gp_per_unit); quadrant assignment per §5.2
RefreshMenuEngineeringService uses OrderDetailRepositoryPort + ProductRepositoryPort + SupplyVariantRepositoryPort + ProductRecipeRepositoryPort for aggregation
ProductUpdatedEvent + RecipeUpdatedEvent: Spring ApplicationEvent published on product price change / recipe change, with event listener that sets cache as stale (or triggers immediate refresh)
RefreshMenuEngineeringJob: @Scheduled @SchedulerLock at 3:00 AM daily, refreshes cache for last 13 months
GetMenuEngineeringUseCase port + GetMenuEngineeringService (reads from cache table, returns series for requested time bucket range)
MenuEngineeringController: GET /api/v1/analytics/menu-engineering with Bearer auth + @PreAuthorize(ADMIN) + optional ?categoryId= filter
MenuEngineeringReportResponse DTO matching the A6 contract shape (§5.2): nested period, median, items[], cacheStatus, dataCompleteness
Cache invalidation: on product.base_price change → invalidate all cache rows for that product; on any product_recipes change → invalidate all cache rows for that product
No BigDecimal-in-domain violations (§6b): all monetary amounts use Money wrapper; quadrant and counts stay plain types
Tests: RefreshMenuEngineeringService (aggregation + median + quadrant assignment), GetMenuEngineeringService (series fill), controller (200/401/403), job cron
